answer_1.quote: We will conduct both automatic and manual blind evaluation on the submitted models... we will manually evaluate system-generated summaries from multiple aspects designed for dialogue summarization.

answer_2.quote: We will report ROUGE and BERTScore. ROUGE measures the overlap of n-grams... BERTScore computes a similarity score between the generated summary and reference summary.

answer_4.quote: All human annotators will read system-generated summaries and rate them based on following criteria. Standard Summarization Metrics: Fluency, Consistency, Relevance and Coherence... Coreference Information... Intent Identification... Discourse Relation... Objective Description... Overview Score.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer questions/criteria covering fluency, consistency, relevance, coherence, coreference, intent, discourse relation, objective description, and overall overview score.
